svg.title: K-Means roadmap
svg.desc: Seven steps from loading data to comparing clusters with known labels, with the variable passed between each step, and a panel showing the assign and update loop that KMeans .fit() runs.
svg.text: K-Means roadmap: how the code blocks connect
Each box is a code block. The label on each arrow is the variable handed to the next block.
